boundary: The strict uniform-prior theorem and neighborhood are analytic under the declared Gaussian/Bernoulli model. It supersedes the prior nearest-grid tie claim. A complete description of every continuous equality surface away from this neighborhood remains open.

joint_policy.policy: Use J1 for every orientation SPRT sample and stop at |k|=5; classify fibre from all accumulated quartic outputs.

orientation_subproblem.Bellman_certificate: Continue exactly for |k|<5 and stop for |k|>=5; exact rational linear equations and inequalities are checked.

projection_diagnosis.conclusion: Nearest-composition projection creates artificial information and violates the exact orientation marginal lower bound. The reported aspirational grid tie is not a valid continuous-model affinity surface.

risk_decomposition.baseline_component_bound: Separate sensing implies V_base >= V_fibre(weight100)+V_orientation(weight200). The fibre term is at least one because stopping initially costs 200/3 and every fibre action costs at least one.

strictness.Lipschitz_argument: Both Bayes value functions are 200-Lipschitz in L1, so their gap changes by at most 400||p-p0||_1.
